title: Inter should bench Lautaro vs Parma — he lands 48 hours before kickoff
caption:
Inter should bench Lautaro against Parma. Per TyC Sport (via FCInter1908), the captain has about 11,000 km to travel home from Argentina and lands in Milan roughly 48 hours before Saturday's kickoff — a start the report calls close to impossible, with seven matches in 21 days to follow. Confirmed by the club: Calhanoglu is back in the group at Appiano Gentile.
